kaushitaki_chapter3_verse4.title: Kaushitaki Chapter 3 Verse 4
kaushitaki_chapter3_verse4.introduction: This verse belongs to Kaushitaki, Chapter 3.
kaushitaki_chapter3_verse4.scripture_text: A representative contemplative passage from the Kaushitaki Upanishad, Chapter 3, Verse 4, reflecting the inquiry into Atman, Brahman, and liberation through self-knowledge.
kaushitaki_chapter3_verse4.philosophical_explanation: This verse extends the contemplative teaching tradition of the Upanishads toward self-knowledge and liberation.
